caption: The drawing depicts a single tall cylindrical ceramic jar with a slightly tapering body and a rounded rim near the top. The jar is rendered in shades of brown with areas of darker and lighter speckling, giving it a textured, earthen appearance. At the upper front of the jar, the word "PLUMBS" is written in blue letters, and directly below the text is a stylized blue floral or abstract emblem. The jar stands upright against a plain, off-white or beige background. In the lower right corner of the drawing, the name "Yolande Delasser" is written in small, clear letters. No other objects or decorations are present in the composition.
